info.name: EduPlatform API — E2E
info.description:
# EduPlatform API — E2E Collection

**⚠️ Payments & refunds are intentionally NOT covered in this collection.**
Payments are cash-only and tested manually.

## How to run

1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your server (default: `http://localhost:3002/api/v1`).
3. Run the folders **in order** (`Preflight → Flow 1 → Flow 2 → Flow 3 → Flow 4 → Flow 5 → Flow 6 → … → Flow 13`).
   Each flow depends on state seeded by earlier flows.
4. Use **Collection Runner** (Runner → select collection → run) to execute all flows in sequence.

## How auth works

Next-auth uses an HTTP-only session cookie. Because multiple users are needed across flows,
each login request extracts the `Set-Cookie` value and stores it in a collection variable
(e.g., `adminCookie`, `teacherCookie`, `studentCookie`). Subsequent requests set
`Cookie: next-auth.session-token={{...Cookie}}` manually.

## Dev-mode assumptions

These endpoints must include extra data in the response's `meta` field **in development**,
stripped in production:

- `POST /roster/students/invite` and `POST /roster/teachers/invite` → `meta.inviteToken` so the
  collection can chain into `POST /auth/invite/accept` without reading email.
- `POST /auth/password/forgot` → `meta.resetToken` (not used in this collection but noted).

If you prefer not to leak tokens through the API, stub these by reading the last message from
your dev email inbox and set the collection variables manually before running the affected
requests.
